fact: 1911年7月1日，德国炮舰“豹”号（SMS Panther）抵达摩洛哥大西洋港口阿加迪尔，官方理由是保护德国贸易利益；数日后，较大的不莱梅级巡洋舰“柏林”号（SMS Berlin）抵达并接替该炮舰。此举发生在法国以保护侨民为由向非斯派兵之后，德方要求对法国扩张摩洛哥给予“领土补偿”。

sources.title: Agadir Crisis (Wikipedia mirror, en.chped.com)
sources.quote: On 1 July, the German gunboat SMS Panther arrived at the port of Agadir, under the pretext of protecting German trade interests. The larger Bremen-class cruiser SMS Berlin came days later, replacing the gunboat.

sources.title: Agadir Crisis (Wikiwand)
sources.quote: The Agadir Crisis, Agadir Incident, or Second Moroccan Crisis, was a brief crisis sparked by the deployment of a substantial force of French troops in the interior of Morocco in July 1911 and the deployment of the German gunboat SMS Panther to Agadir, a Moroccan Atlantic port. Germany did not object to France's expansion but demanded "territorial compensation" for itself.

fact: 1911年7月21日，英国财政大臣劳合·乔治在伦敦市长官邸（Mansion House）发表演说，称若英国在切身利益受损之处被轻慢对待、“仿佛在列国议事中无足轻重”，则以此为代价的和平“是我们这样的大国无法忍受的屈辱”。演说被柏林解读为英国不会接受德国强加的摩洛哥解决方案；部分资料将该演说日期记为7月20日。

sources.title: Agadir Crisis (Wikipedia mirror, en.chped.com)
sources.quote: On 21 July, David Lloyd George delivered a speech at the Mansion House, London in which he declared that national honour was more precious than peace: "If Britain is treated badly where her interests are vitally affected, as if she is of no account in the cabinet of nations, then I say emphatically that peace at that price would be a humiliation intolerable for a great country like ours to endure." The speech was interpreted by Germany as a warning that she could not impose an unreasonable settlement on France.

sources.title: Agadir Crisis (Wikiwand)
sources.quote: In Britain, David Lloyd George, then Chancellor of the Exchequer, made a dramatic "Mansion House" speech on 20 July 1911—with the consent of prime minister H. H. Asquith and Foreign Secretary, Sir Edward Grey, bypassing the non-interventionist majority in the Cabinet—that denounced the German move as an intolerable humiliation.

fact: 1911年7月15日，德国提出谈判条件：可让出喀麦隆北部与多哥部分地区，但要求法国交出从桑加河到海口的整个法属刚果，后又追加法国对葡属刚果（比属刚果）优先购买权的转让。

sources.title: Agadir Crisis (Wikiwand)
sources.quote: The German terms, as presented on 15 July, while containing an offer to cede the northern part of Kamerun and Togoland, demanded from France the whole of the French Congo from the Sangha River to the sea, to which was later added the transfer of France's right to the preemption of the Belgian Congo.

fact: 1911年11月4日，法德两国就摩洛哥问题达成协议（《摩洛哥—刚果条约》）：德国承认法国在摩洛哥的地位，法国则把法属赤道非洲约27.5万平方公里土地让予德国喀麦隆（即“新喀麦隆”），德国另将喀麦隆东南一小块土地让予法属乍得。法国对摩洛哥的保护国地位于1912年3月30日正式确立。

sources.title: Agadir Crisis (Wikipedia mirror, en.chped.com)
sources.quote: Negotiations between Berlin and Paris resolved the crisis on 4 November 1911: France took over Morocco as a protectorate in exchange for territorial concessions to German Cameroon from the French Congo.

sources.title: Agadir Crisis (Wikiwand)
sources.quote: This 275,000 km2 (106,000 sq mi) territory, known as Neukamerun, became part of the German colony of Kamerun.

fact: 1911年版《大英百科全书》引英国贸易委员会报告：柏林两室住房的周租常见区间为5先令至6先令，三室为7先令至9先令3便士；柏林的租金高于德国其他任何城市，斯图加特接近其水平。另据 1909—1917 年柏林招租广告的研究，1907—1910 年德国租金平均占收入 17%—18%，年收入低于 1200 马克的家庭有 20% 的预算用于房租。

sources.title: 1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica, Vol. 13, p. 850 (Wikisource)
sources.quote: With regard to rents the Board of Trade (London) Report gives the following figures for Berlin and a number of other towns:— No. of Rooms per Dwelling. Predominant Range of Weekly Rents. Berlin. Other Towns. 2 rooms 5/- to 6/- 2/8 to 3/6 3 rooms 7/- to 9/3 3/6 to 4/9 4 rooms .. 4/3 to 6/- Rents are higher in Berlin than in any other town, though Stuttgart comes very near it.

sources.title: Konstantin Kholodilin, War, Housing Rents, and Free Market: A Case of Berlin's Rental Housing Market during the World War I (DIW Berlin Discussion Paper 1477, 2015)
sources.quote: In 1907–1910, rental payments made up an average of 17–18 percent of income in Germany, while families with the lowest incomes (below 1,200 Marks a year) spent 20 percent of their budget on rent (Ascher 1917, p. 98).

fact: 1911年出版的柏林旅行指南称：在柏林出行便宜，乘电车走将近十英里只需一便士，马车omnibus走很远只需其一半价钱；柏林街头没有乞丐，穷人衣着整洁；柏林警察“在自己眼中是非常重要的角色”，不容轻慢。

sources.title: Edith Siepen, Peeps At Great Cities: Berlin (1911), extracts on Slow Travel Berlin
sources.quote: “Getting about is cheap in Berlin. You can go a distance of nearly ten miles in an electric tram for a penny, and the horse omnibus will take you quite a long way for half that sum.”

sources.title: Edith Siepen, Peeps At Great Cities: Berlin (1911), extracts on Slow Travel Berlin
sources.quote: “There are no street beggars in Berlin, and you are at once impressed by the tidy appearance of the poor people.” … “A Berlin policeman is a very important individual indeed in his own estimation, and there is no trifling with him.”

fact: 1911年德意志帝国的选举权是两套并行制度：帝国议会（Reichstag）实行25岁以上男性普遍、平等、秘密、直接的选举权；普鲁士邦议会（Abgeordnetenhaus）则实行三级选举制，433名议员由间接选举产生，选民按纳税额分为三级，每级选出等额选举人，投票不秘密，因而纳税多者的一票权重远高于穷人。

sources.title: 1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica/Prussia (Wikisource)
sources.quote: The Abgeordnetenhaus or chamber of deputies, consists of 433 members, elected for periods of five years by indirect suffrage, exercised by all male citizens who have reached the age of twenty-five and have not forfeited their communal rights. The original electors are arranged in three classes, according to the rate of taxes paid by them, in such a way that the gross amount of taxation is equal in each class.

sources.title: Reichstag (German Empire) (Wikiwand)
sources.quote: It had one of the most progressive electoral laws of its time: with only a few restrictions, all male citizens 25 and older were allowed to vote, secretly and equally, in direct elections.

fact: 1911年阿加迪尔危机期间，德国发生金融恐慌：股市单日暴跌30%，公众开始以纸币兑换黄金，银行出现挤兑，帝国银行在一个月内损失五分之一黄金储备；当时传闻称法国财长策划了这场资金提取。面临被迫脱离金本位的风险，德皇在摩洛哥问题上让步。

sources.title: 利雅卡特·艾哈迈德《金融之王》第三章（中译本，查字典图书网）
sources.quote: 危机中期,德国受到了金融恐慌的严重打击。股票市场一天内暴跌30%,公众开始失去信心,国内爆发了银行挤兑,人们开始要求用货币兑换黄金。这种潮流在整个国家风起云涌,而德意志银行在一个月内就损失了1/5 的黄金储备。

sources.title: Agadir Crisis (Wikipedia mirror, en.wikipadia.org)
sources.quote: The stock market plunged by 30 percent in a single day, the public started cashing in currency notes for gold, and there was a run on the banks. The Reichsbank lost a fifth of its gold reserves in one month.

fact: 阿加迪尔危机数月后，德皇召集包括帝国银行行长鲁道夫·冯·哈芬施泰因在内的银行家，询问帝国银行是否有能力支持一场欧洲战争；银行家迟疑后，德皇告诫“下次我问你们这个问题时，希望从你们这些绅士口中得到一个不同的答案”。此后德国政府要求银行增持黄金，帝国银行的黄金储备从阿加迪尔时期的约两亿美元增至1914年的约五亿美元，同期英格兰银行约为两亿美元。

sources.title: 利雅卡特·艾哈迈德《金融之王》第三章（中译本，查字典图书网）
sources.quote: 几个月后,心灵创伤还未平复的德皇召集了一批银行家,其中包括德意志银行行长鲁道夫• 冯• 哈芬施泰因,询问他们德意志银行是否有能力为一场欧洲战争提供支持。当这些银行家表现出犹豫的神色后,他告诫他们:“下次我问你们这个问题时,我希望从你们这些绅士们口中得到一个不同的答案。”……政府要求银行加强它们的黄金储备,德意志银行把储备从阿加迪尔时期的两亿美元增加到1914 年的5 亿美元,相比较而言,英格兰银行却只有两亿美元的储备。

fact: 齐柏林 LZ 10“施瓦本”号于1911年6月26日首飞，7月16日投入德国飞艇旅行公司（DELAG）的客运，被齐柏林博物馆与相关文献视为历史上第一架商业上成功的载客航空器：至1912年6月失事，它共完成224次飞行、载运4354人次，其中1553人为付费乘客；到1914年8月一战爆发前，DELAG累计飞行1588架次、运送10197名付费乘客。

sources.title: LZ 10 SCHWABEN – the first successful DELAG airship (Zeppelin Museum Friedrichshafen)
sources.quote: From these locations, one- or two-hour sightseeing flights would depart every morning, weather permitting. In this way, the airship completed 224 flights, carrying 4,354 passengers – 1,553 of them paying customers – and spent 479 hours in the air.

sources.title: Zeppelin (Wikiwand)
sources.quote: The company's fortunes changed with the next ship, LZ 10 Schwaben, which first flew on 26 June 1911 and carried 1,553 passengers in 218 flights before catching fire after a gust tore it from its mooring near Düsseldorf. … By the outbreak of World War I in August 1914, 1588 flights had carried 10,197 fare-paying passengers.
